question: The famous novel ‘Pinjar’ based on riots during the Indian independence, was written by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrita Pritam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pinjar**

 
 
• **Amrita Pritam**, a renowned poet and novelist, wrote '**Pinjar' in Punjabi a famous novel based on riots during the Indian independence in 1950**. 
 
• The novel '**Pinjar'**, which is set around the time of** India's Partition**, is widely regarded as one of **the best pieces of Indian fiction ever written**.
 
• The story is based on a** Hindu girl, Puro, who is kidnapped by Rashid, a Muslim guy, and when Puro escapes from Rashid's house, her parents refuse to accept the defiled daughter**.
 
• The** 2003 Hindi film Pinjar**, with **Urmila Matondkar, Manoj Bajpai, and Sanjay Suri in the lead roles**, was an adaptation of the book.
 
• The movie won the **National Film Award for Best Feature Film on National Integration **after receiving critical acclaim. 
 
• On **January 25, 2018**,** TVOne Pakistan premiered a Pakistani television **series titled as **Ghughi, **based on the book.
 
 
 
• **Amrita Pritam **
 
 
• Amrita Pritam was an** Indian novelist, poet, and essayist who wrote in Punjabi and Hindi**.
 
• She was born on **August 31, 1919**.
 
• She is a well-known author in** Punjabi literature and the 1956 Sahitya Akademi Award winner**.
 
• Her body of work included more than **100 books that were all translated into numerous Indian and international languages**.
 
• These books included** poetry, fiction, biographies, essays, a collection of Punjabi folk melodies**, and an **autobiography**.
